title: arnegiacomo/fugleramme: a local-AI bird frame for Raspberry Pi
friendlyTitle: Build a picture frame that hears and shows nearby birds
summary: Fugleramme listens for birds with local audio recognition, then shows matching public-domain bird illustrations on an e-ink display. The Raspberry Pi project keeps recognition on the device and has attracted about 2,800 GitHub stars.
friendlySummary: Fugleramme uses a Raspberry Pi and local AI to identify bird sounds. It then shows an old-style illustration of the bird on an e-ink screen.
whyItMatters: It is a complete, approachable example of local AI joining sensors, classification and a low-power display. Makers can build the frame as designed or reuse its architecture for private, ambient recognition projects.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is a practical project for learning how local AI can connect a microphone, recognition software and a low-power display without sending audio to the cloud.
howItsUseful: It is a complete, approachable example of local AI joining sensors, classification and a low-power display. Makers can build the frame as designed or reuse its architecture for private, ambient recognition projects.
